内容
提要
上集 "空城计"，叙马谡违令失街亭，诸葛亮用
空城计吓退司马懿。
本集叙东吴鄱阳太守周鲂献平吴七策，诈降魏将
曹休。曹休中计，引兵深入吴境。孙权拜陆逊为平北大都督，
伏兵石亭，大破曹兵。
下集 "姜维献书"，叙姜维用诈降计击败魏大都督曹真，
诸葛亮二出祁山。
1. 孔明用空城计退去司马懿大军，斩了不守军纪的马谡，回军汉中，从事
练兵和储粮。细作探得情况，报入洛阳，魏主曹睿闻知，便召司马懿商议
攻打两川的计策。
page_text_en:
Content
Summary
Last episode "The Empty City Strategy": It narrates how Ma Su disobeyed orders and lost Jieting, and Zhuge Liang used the Empty City Strategy to scare off Sima Yi.
This episode narrates how Zhou Fang, the governor of Poyang in Eastern Wu, presented seven strategies to pacify Wu, feigned surrender to Wei general Cao Xiu. Cao Xiu fell for the trick, led his troops deep into Wu territory. Sun Quan appointed Lu Xun as the Grand Commander of the Northern Campaign, ambushed the Wei army at Shiting, and decisively defeated Cao's forces.
Next episode "Jiang Wei Presents a Letter": It narrates how Jiang Wei used a feigned surrender to defeat Wei's Grand Commander Cao Zhen, and Zhuge Liang launched his second campaign from Qishan.
1. Kongming used the Empty City Strategy to repel Sima Yi's army, executed Ma Su for violating military discipline, returned to Hanzhong, and focused on training troops and storing grain. Scouts reported the situation to Luoyang; Emperor Cao Rui, upon hearing this, summoned Sima Yi to discuss strategies for attacking Liang and Shu.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《三国演义之四十八》的第2页，包含内容提要和第一幅插图及文字说明。内容提要回顾了上集“空城计”，介绍了本集“赚曹休”的情节概要，并预告了下集“姜维献书”。插图描绘了魏主曹睿在殿中召见司马懿商议军务的场景，下方文字说明了诸葛亮退敌、斩马谡后，魏主曹睿得知消息并召司马懿商议攻打两川的计策。

那再好没有，你且说出人来。
臣已料定孔明不出兵使罢，要出兵只有通过陈仓一路。臣推荐一人把守那边，便告万无一失。
2. 司马懿以为暂时不宜用兵，现下天气炎热，蜀兵未必出战，倘我军进攻，对方扼守险要，也恐不易取胜。
3. 司马懿荐举了郝昭，说此人一向带兵镇守河西，武艺高强，深通兵法，足可抵敌孔明。曹睿大喜，随即派人拿了诏书，封郝昭做镇西将军，调他把守陈仓。
page_text_en:
That's perfect, now name the person.
I have already determined that Kongming will not launch an attack. If we must march, we can only do so through Chen Cang. I recommend one person to guard that area, and victory will be assured.
2. Sima Yi believed it was not advisable to launch an attack at present. The weather is hot, and Shu forces may not engage. Even if we advance, they will likely hold the strategic passes, making victory difficult.
3. Sima Yi recommended Hao Zhao, saying this man has long commanded troops in Hexi, is highly skilled in martial arts, deeply versed in military strategy, and fully capable of resisting Kongming. Cao Rui was delighted, immediately sent someone to fetch the imperial decree, appointed Hao Zhao as General of the Western Region, and ordered him to guard Chen Cang.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了魏主曹睿与司马懿商议军事的情景。司马懿认为不宜立即出兵，随后推荐郝昭镇守陈仓，曹睿采纳建议并封郝昭为镇西将军。

4. 曹睿才放下一头心事，忽报扬州大都督曹休上表，说东吴鄱阳太守周鲂，意欲降魏。秘密差人前来接洽，献上灭吴的七条计策，可以一举攻下东吴。
5. 曹睿坐在御榻上，和司马懿一同看表，心里将信将疑。
page_text_en:
4. Cao Rui had just put his mind at ease when he was suddenly informed that Cao Xiu, the Grand Commander of Yangzhou, had submitted a memorial stating that Zhou Fang, the Governor of Poyang in Eastern Wu, wished to defect to Wei. Zhou Fang had secretly sent envoys to make contact and presented seven strategies for conquering Wu, which could lead to the swift defeat of Eastern Wu.
5. Cao Rui sat on the imperial couch, reading the memorial together with Sima Yi, his mind filled with doubt.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了曹休上表称东吴鄱阳太守周鲂欲降魏，并献上灭吴七策，曹睿与司马懿一同审阅奏表，心存疑虑。

6. 司马懿奏道：“周鲂很有诚意，眼看东吴可以平定了。臣愿率领一支军去帮助曹休。”

7. 这时建威将军贾逵站了起来，反对说：“东吴反复无常，不可轻信。周鲂是著名厉害的人，决不会投降，这是引诱我们出兵的诡计罢了。”曹睿想了一会，到底还是同意了司马懿的主张。

不必争执，你们两人可以各自带兵去协助曹休。
page_text_en:
6. Sima Yi presented his opinion: "Zhou Fang is very sincere; it seems we can pacify Eastern Wu. I am willing to lead an army to assist Cao Xiu."

7. At this moment, General Jia Ku of Jianwei rose and objected: "Eastern Wu is fickle and cannot be trusted lightly. Zhou Fang is a renowned and formidable person; he would never surrender. This is a trick to lure us into sending troops." Cao Rui thought for a while and ultimately agreed with Sima Yi's proposal.

There's no need to argue. You two may each lead your troops to assist Cao Xiu.
summary_zh: 司马懿主张出兵援助曹休，认为周鲂投降可信；贾逵反对，认为是东吴的诱敌之计；曹睿最终同意司马懿的主张，并决定让司马懿和贾逵各自率兵协助曹休。

8. 于是曹睿下令，命曹休径取皖城；贾逵统领满宠、胡质，进攻阳城，直指武昌东关；司马懿另率人马攻取江陵。各路大军，便分头出发。
9. 却说吴主孙权，早已同意周鲂诈降，引诱敌军深入，闻得魏兵分三路而来，忙在武昌东关，召集文武百官会议，商量破敌之策。
page_text_en:
8. Thus, Cao Rui gave orders: Cao Xiu was to directly attack Wancheng; Jia Kui, leading Man Chong and Hu Zhi, was to attack Yangcheng, advancing toward the East Gate of Wuchang; Sima Yi would lead another force to capture Jiangling. The various armies then set out separately.
9. Meanwhile, Wu's ruler Sun Quan had already agreed to Zhou Fang's feigned surrender, intending to lure the enemy deep into his territory. Upon hearing that Wei's troops were advancing in three separate routes, he hurriedly convened a meeting of his civil and military officials at the East Gate of Wuchang to discuss strategies for defeating the enemy.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了魏国分三路大军进攻东吴的军事部署，以及吴主孙权得知消息后，在武昌东关召集文武百官商议破敌之策的情景。

10. 顾雍进言：“这一战关系不小，非陆逊不能担当这个重任。”孙权听了，正合心意。
11. 孙权把陆逊召来，封为辅国大将军。陆逊保举朱桓做左都督，全琮做右都督，孙权都依了他。
page_text_en:
10. Gu Yong advised, 'This battle is of great importance; only Lu Xun can shoulder this responsibility.' Sun Quan listened and was pleased.
11. Sun Quan summoned Lu Xun and appointed him as General of the Auxiliary State. Lu Xun recommended Zhu Huan as Left Commander and Quan Cong as Right Commander, and Sun Quan agreed to both.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴君臣商议抗魏对策的场景。顾雍建议由陆逊统兵，孙权采纳；随后孙权任命陆逊为辅国大将军，并依其推荐任命朱桓和全琮为左右都督。

12. 陆逊领命而出，孙权直送到门外；陆逊上马，孙权又给他执着马鞭。众人见孙权如此敬重陆逊，无不赞叹。
13. 陆逊先传令诸葛瑾严密防守江陵，挡住司马懿那一路兵。
page_text_en:
12. Lu Xun accepted his orders and left; Sun Quan personally saw him off to the gate. When Lu Xun mounted his horse, Sun Quan handed him the reins. Everyone admired how respectfully Sun Quan treated Lu Xun.
13. Lu Xun first ordered Zhuge Jin to strictly defend Jiangling and block the army led by Sima Yi.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了孙权亲自送别陆逊并为其执鞭，众人赞叹其敬重之情；随后陆逊下令诸葛瑾严密防守江陵，以抵御司马懿的军队。

14. 他自领中军，朱桓在左，全琮在右，七十余万人马一同进发。
15. 左都督朱桓向陆逊献计道：“曹休无勇无谋，一战失败，必从夹石、桂车两路退走。我和全琮各引一军埋伏山坳，截断他的退路，便可捉住曹休。长驱直进，不难直捣许都、洛阳，大将军以为怎样？ ”
page_text_en:
14. He led the central army himself, with Zhu Huan on the left and Quan Cong on the right, advancing with over seventy thousand troops.
15. Left General Zhu Huan offered a strategy to Lu Xun: "Cao Xiu is both cowardly and lacking in strategy. After one defeat, he will surely retreat via Jia Shi and Gui Che. My troops and Quan Cong's will each set an ambush in the mountain passes to cut off his retreat, and we can capture Cao Xiu. Then, advancing directly, we can easily reach Xu Du and Luoyang. What do you think, General?"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴军队出征的场景，以及左都督朱桓向陆逊献计，建议在曹休败退时于夹石、桂车两路设伏截击，以图直捣魏国都城。

16. 陆逊听了，淡淡一笑，他以为朱桓的想法太简单，要破曹休，自己另有妙计。朱桓见陆逊不用他的计策，心怀不平，默默地退了出去。
17. 再说曹休率领大军，向前推进，不消几日，已近皖城。
page_text_en:
16. Lu Xun listened, smiled faintly, thinking Zhu Huan's idea too simple; to defeat Cao Xiu, he had his own clever plan. Zhu Huan, seeing Lu Xun reject his strategy, felt resentful and silently withdrew.
17. Meanwhile, Cao Xiu led his army forward, and within a few days, they approached Wan City.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了陆逊拒绝朱桓的计策，认为自有妙计，朱桓心怀不平退下；同时，曹休率军推进，已接近皖城。

18. 周鲂从防地赶来，径入大帐，拜见曹休。
19. 曹休很客气地接待周鲂，说：“你密奏的灭吴七策，天子觉得深有道理，所以起三路大军前来。这回倘得了江东地方，你的功劳着实不小。”
page_text_en:
18. Zhou Fang came from the frontier, entered the main tent directly, and paid respects to Cao Xiu.
19. Cao Xiu received Zhou Fang politely and said, "Your secret proposal of the seven strategies to destroy Wu has been found very reasonable by the Emperor, so we have mobilized three armies to advance. If we succeed in capturing the Jiangdong region, your merit will indeed be great."
summary_zh: 周鲂抵达曹休大营并拜见，曹休对其表示欢迎，并肯定其献上的灭吴七策，称魏国已派三路大军出征，若成功夺取江东，周鲂功劳甚大。

20. 周鲂正要谦逊，曹休忽然话锋一转，正色说：“有人说你惯于用计，恐怕这次也是别有用意，可是我相信你一定不会这样待我。”
21. 周鲂先是装作吃惊，接着泪水直涌，大哭起来。
page_text_en:
20. Zhou Fang was about to be modest, but Cao Xiu suddenly changed the subject and said seriously, "Some people say you are used to using tricks. Perhaps this time too, you have ulterior motives. But I believe you certainly won't treat me like that."
21. Zhou Fang first pretended to be shocked, then tears welled up and he burst into tears.
summary_zh: 曹休在大营中对周鲂表示信任，周鲂则装作受宠若惊并痛哭流涕，以示忠诚。

22. 曹休一怔，要待劝慰，只听嚓的一声，周鲂已从随员身上拔出宝剑，就向自己的颈项抹去。
23. 曹休大惊，慌忙去夺宝剑。周鲂死命不放，定要自杀。
page_text_en:
22. Cao Xiu was startled and about to comfort him, when he heard a 'chacha' sound — Zhou Fang had already drawn a sword from his attendant's body and was slashing toward his own neck.
23. Cao Xiu was greatly alarmed and hurriedly tried to snatch the sword. Zhou Fang refused to let go, determined to commit suicide.
summary_zh: 周鲂在曹休大营中拔剑自刎，曹休惊慌夺剑，周鲂坚持要自杀以表忠心。

我说着玩罢了，你何必认真呢。
24. 周鲂气愤愤地说道：“我恨不得吐出心肝来，你们倒反来怀疑我。看样子是有人在使反间计。如果中了他们的诡计，我是活不成的了。”
25. 周鲂说了，又要自刎，曹休连忙把他拉住。
page_text_en:
I was just joking, why take it seriously?
24. Zhou Fang angrily said, "I wish I could spit out my heart and liver. You people are the ones who doubt me. It seems someone is using a counter-intelligence plot. If I fall for their trick, I won't survive."
25. After speaking, Zhou Fang tried to commit suicide again, and Cao Xiu hurriedly pulled him back.
summary_zh: 周鲂在曹休大营中因被怀疑而情绪激动，声称若中计将无法活命，并再次试图自刎，曹休急忙将其拉住以阻止。

27. 周鲂将头发掷在地上，激昂地说：‘我用赤诚待都督，都督却故意戏弄。现在我只有割掉父母所遗的头发，表明我的心迹。’
page_text_en:
26. Cao Xiu let go, and Zhou Fang suddenly drew his sword and cut off a large clump of his own hair.

summary_zh: 周鲂在曹休大营中因被怀疑而情绪激动，为表忠心，他挥剑割下自己一大把头发并掷于地上，声称此举以证明其赤诚之心。

28. 周鲂一番做作，曹休再也不疑，连忙摆酒设宴，替周鲂消气。席上，两人又谈了许多机密，直待宾主都喝得醉熏熏的，周鲂才告辞回去。
29. 下一天，贾逵来见曹休，说东吴在皖城可能驻有重兵，不宜轻进。他愿意协助曹休，两下夹攻。
page_text_en:
28. After Zhou Fang's dramatic display, Cao Xiu no longer doubted him, and immediately arranged a banquet to soothe Zhou Fang's mood. During the feast, the two discussed many secrets, and only after both host and guest were thoroughly drunk did Zhou Fang take his leave.
29. The next day, Jia Kui came to see Cao Xiu, saying that Eastern Wu might have a large force stationed in Wan City, and it would be unwise to advance lightly. He offered to assist Cao Xiu in a pincer attack.
summary_zh: 周鲂通过激烈举动消除曹休疑虑，曹休设宴款待并与其密谈；次日，贾逵劝曹休勿轻进皖城，并提议协同夹攻。

30. 曹休没等贾逵说完，便发怒道：“这哪里是什么夹攻，分明是你想分我的功劳罢了。”

31. 贾逵忍耐着不辩，再劝曹休：“周鲂诡计多端，割发为誓，明明是做作，不可深信。”曹休越发恼怒起来，立刻叫左右把贾逵绑起，推出斩首。

我正要进兵，你却来动摇军心，太可恶了！
page_text_en:
30. Cao Xiu didn't wait for Jia Kui to finish speaking, and angrily said, "This is not a joint attack at all; it's clearly your attempt to share my merit!"

31. Jia Kui endured silently and urged Cao Xiu again, "Zhou Fang is full of deceit; his act of cutting his hair as an oath is clearly pretense and should not be trusted." Cao Xiu became even more furious and immediately ordered his attendants to bind Jia Kui and lead him out for execution.

I was about to advance, yet you come to undermine morale—how despicable!
summary_zh: 曹休因贾逵劝阻其进军而恼怒，认为其意图分功，遂下令将贾逵绑起推出斩首，贾逵劝谏未果，曹休情绪激动，斥责其动摇军心。

32. 众将领一齐上前讨情，说尚未进兵，先斩大将，这是不吉利的。曹休勉强允了，命将贾逵留在军中调用。
33. 周鲂探得贾逵削去兵权，心中暗喜，自忖：假如曹休听了贾逵的话，东吴岂不完蛋了。当下秘密差人到皖城，把这情形报知陆逊。
page_text_en:
32. The generals all stepped forward to plead, saying it was unlucky to execute a general before advancing. Cao Xiu reluctantly agreed and ordered Jia Kui to remain in the army for assignment.
33. Zhou Fang learned that Jia Kui had been stripped of his command, and secretly rejoiced, thinking: If Cao Xiu had listened to Jia Kui, Eastern Wu would surely be doomed. He immediately sent a secret messenger to Wan City to report this to Lu Xun.
summary_zh: 曹休因贾逵劝阻进军而欲斩之，众将劝阻后曹休勉强赦免并留贾逵在军中；周鲂得知贾逵被削权后暗喜，并秘密派人将消息报知陆逊。

35. 曹休急切要立功，自率一军来攻皖城，命周鲂带路。周鲂求之不得，一路领着曹休前进。
page_text_en:
34. Upon receiving the report, Lu Xun summoned his generals to discuss. He said that ahead of Wan City, there was a place called Shiting. Although it was mountainous, it was suitable for ambushing a large army. They must first occupy the open area there, form their battle array, and meet the enemy. He then appointed Xu Sheng as vanguard and ordered him to advance.
35. Cao Xiu, eager to achieve merit, personally led his army to attack Wan City and ordered Zhou Fang to lead the way. Zhou Fang was delighted and led Cao Xiu forward along the way.
summary_zh: 陆逊得知曹休进军后，召集将领商议，在石亭布阵以待；曹休则急于立功，亲自率军进攻皖城，并命周鲂带路，周鲂欣然领命引路前行。

“那边地名石亭，里面地方空阔，正好驻扎大兵。”
37. 曹休不疑，指挥全军并车仗粮食，一齐开到石亭扎营。
page_text_en:
36. After marching for a while, Cao Xiu saw a valley ahead, dense with trees, and asked Zhou Fang. Zhou Fang said: 
"That place is called Shiting; it's spacious inside, perfect for camping a large army." 
37. Cao Xiu, without suspicion, commanded the entire army, along with their supply wagons and food, to march together to Shiting and set up camp.
summary_zh: 曹休在周鲂的指引下，率军进入名为石亭的山坳，并决定在此扎营。

38. 下一天，忽然哨马来报：‘前面发现吴兵甚多，据守山口。’
39. 曹休闻报，大吃一惊，心想周鲂说过沿路无兵，何以吴兵把守山隘？急忙差人去找周鲂。
page_text_en:
38. The next day, a scout suddenly reported: 'A large number of Wu troops have been spotted, holding the mountain pass.'
39. Cao Xiu, upon hearing the report, was greatly shocked. He thought to himself, 'Zhou Fang said there were no troops along the way. Why are Wu troops guarding the mountain pass?' He immediately sent someone to find Zhou Fang.
summary_zh: 曹休大军行至石亭，哨兵报告前方山口有大量吴军把守，曹休大惊，因周鲂曾言沿途无兵，遂怀疑其诈降，急忙派人寻找周鲂。

41. 他自恃兵马众多，却也不怕，忙下令张普任前锋，率领几千兵去和吴兵交战。
page_text_en:
40. A messenger reported: Zhou Fang had taken dozens of men and no one knew where he had gone. Cao Xiu realized he had been tricked, feeling both regret and anger.
41. He, relying on his large army, was not afraid and quickly ordered Zhang Pu to lead several thousand troops to engage the Wu forces in battle.
summary_zh: 曹休得知周鲂带人失踪后，意识到自己中计，既懊悔又恼怒；但他仍自恃兵多，下令张普率兵迎战吴军。

42. 两阵对圆，张普出马，大叫：‘贼将何在？快来投降。’
43. 徐盛出阵迎战，战了几合，张普抵敌不住。
page_text_en:
42. The two armies faced each other. Zhang Pu rode out and shouted, 'Where is the rebel general? Surrender quickly!' 
43. Xu Sheng rode out to meet him. After a few rounds of combat, Zhang Pu could not withstand the attack.
summary_zh: 曹休派张普率兵迎战吴军，张普出阵挑战，吴将徐盛应战，数回合后张普不敌。

44. 张普勒马收兵，回见曹休，说徐盛勇不可当。曹休也不责备张普，就是要用奇兵来破吴军。
45. 曹休令张普带二万人马埋伏石亭南面，薛乔带二万人马埋伏石亭北面。准备明天用诈败计引诱吴兵追来，三面夹攻，可获全胜。
page_text_en:
44. Zhang Pu reined in his horse and withdrew his troops, returning to report to Cao Xiu, saying that Xu Sheng was invincible. Cao Xiu did not reprimand Zhang Pu, but instead decided to use a surprise tactic to defeat the Wu army.
45. Cao Xiu ordered Zhang Pu to lead 20,000 troops to lie in ambush to the south of Shiting, and Xue Qiao to lead 20,000 troops to lie in ambush to the north of Shiting. He planned to use a feigned retreat the next day to lure the Wu troops into pursuit, then launch a three-pronged attack to achieve a complete victory.
summary_zh: 张普败回后向曹休报告徐盛勇猛，曹休未责怪他，转而决定用奇兵破敌；随后曹休部署张普和薛乔分别在石亭南北埋伏，计划次日以诈败诱敌，实施三面夹攻。

47. 不料人马越来越多，张普起疑，挺枪上马，赶去探问。
page_text_en:
46. At the second watch, Zhang Pu's forces had just finished setting up their ambush, when suddenly they saw troops moving in the darkness behind their camp. Zhang Pu assumed they were Wei reinforcements and paid no mind.
47. Unexpectedly, the number of troops kept growing. Zhang Pu became suspicious, mounted his horse with his spear, and rushed forward to investigate.
summary_zh: 张普在石亭埋伏时，发现寨后有不明人马移动，起初以为是魏军接应，但随着人马增多，他起疑并骑马前去探查。

49. 张普猝不及防，拨马就走。朱桓哪肯放过，追上一刀，张普落马而死。
page_text_en:
48. Not far ahead, a general suddenly appeared from the side—it was Zhu Huan of Eastern Wu. Originally, Lu Xun had ordered Zhu Huan and Quan Cong, each leading 30,000 troops, to take a mountain path to the rear of the Wei camp, set fire to it, and launch a surprise attack, while Lu Xun himself led the main force from the center to capture Cao Xiu alive.
49. Zhang Pu, caught off guard, turned his horse to flee. Zhu Huan, unwilling to let him escape, chased after him and struck with a single slash, causing Zhang Pu to fall from his horse and die.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴将领朱桓率军从后方突袭魏军，张普猝不及防被朱桓追杀身亡的场景，揭示了陆逊三路夹击的计策已开始实施。

51. 全琮这一路兵抄到魏寨后面，正撞在薛乔阵里。
page_text_en:
50. The Wei soldiers were in chaos, fleeing in panic, so Zhu Huan ordered his troops to set fire.
51. Quan Cong's troops arrived from behind the Wei camp and collided directly with Xue Qiao's formation.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴军队对魏军的两路突袭：朱桓率军放火追击溃败的魏兵，全琮则率军抄到魏寨后方，与薛乔的部队正面相撞，展现了陆逊三路夹击计策的全面展开。

53. 薛乔死命冲突，杀开一条血路，奔向曹休大寨。
page_text_en:
52. Xue Qiao did not expect the Wu army's night attack and hurriedly engaged in battle. That Quan Cong charged straight into the densest crowds, and the Wei soldiers could not withstand it, fleeing in panic. The Wu army surrounded them from all sides, and their forces kept growing.
53. Xue Qiao fought desperately, carving a bloody path through the enemy, and rushed toward Cao Xiu's main camp.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴将领全琮率军夜袭魏军，薛乔仓促应战，魏军溃败，薛乔奋力突围奔向曹休大寨的场景，展现了陆逊三路夹击计策的全面实施。

55. 朱桓、全琮两军合做一路，直扑曹休本寨。
page_text_en:
54. Quan Cong chased the enemy while ordering his troops to set fire, causing a great defeat for the Wei army with countless casualties.
55. Zhu Huan and Quan Cong's forces joined together and rushed straight toward Cao Xiu's main camp.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了东吴将领全琮率军追击溃败的魏军并放火，造成魏军重大伤亡；随后朱桓与全琮两军会合，直扑曹休大寨，展现了陆逊三路夹击计策的全面实施。

57. 刚出营帐，只见薛乔狼狈逃回，说是张普被斩，北山南山两路都被吴军袭了。曹休心惊胆战，慌得没了主意。
page_text_en:
56. Cao Xiu was dreaming of defeating Xu Sheng the next day, when suddenly he heard the whole camp drumming and shouting, saying that flames were rising ahead and the cries were shaking the heavens and earth. Realizing something was wrong, he hurriedly put on his clothes and mounted his horse.
57. Just as he stepped out of his tent, he saw Xue Qiao fleeing in disarray, reporting that Zhang Pu had been beheaded and that both the northern and southern routes had been attacked by Wu forces. Cao Xiu was terrified and panicked, losing all composure.
summary_zh: 曹休在帐中做梦时被军营骚乱惊醒，发现前方火光冲天、喊声震天，慌忙披衣上马；刚出营帐，便见薛乔狼狈逃回，报告张普被斩、南北两路均遭吴军袭击，曹休惊慌失措，不知所措。

page_text_en:
58. In an instant, the Wu army arrived in force, causing chaos among the Wei troops, who collided with each other. Cao Xiu galloped his horse toward the narrow stone path to escape.
59. At this moment, Xu Sheng led a large force of troops down the main road, and Cao Xiu became even more panicked, desperately galloping through the narrow stone path.
summary_zh: 吴军主力追击，魏军大乱，曹休慌忙逃入夹石道；徐盛率军从正面杀来，曹休在夹石道中惊慌逃窜。

61. 曹休惊魂略定，再看一下贾逵，不觉满心惭愧，于是叹息说：“我不听你的话，结果遭此惨败！”
page_text_en:
60. Suddenly, another force burst out from a narrow path. Cao Xiu was terrified, thinking his life was over. But when he looked closely, it was Jia Kui.
61. Cao Xiu calmed down slightly, looked at Jia Kui again, and felt deeply ashamed. He sighed, saying, "I didn't listen to you, and now I've suffered this disastrous defeat!"
summary_zh: 曹休在逃亡途中遭遇贾逵，误以为是敌军而惊恐万分，后认出是贾逵，因不听其劝告导致惨败而深感惭愧。

page_text_en:
62. Jia Kui did not mind, and hurriedly urged, "Commander, quickly charge out of the narrow stone pass. If the Wu soldiers block the way with trees and rocks, we will never escape."
63. Cao Xiu, reminded by Jia Kui, hurriedly spurred his horse forward, while Jia Kui led the rear guard to hold off the enemy's pursuit.
summary_zh: 曹休在贾逵的提醒下，急令其断后，自己率先冲出夹石道，以躲避吴军追击。

page_text_en:

source_file: 连环画《三国演义48：赚曹休》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
68. 司马懿听到曹休大败的消息，深怕孔明乘虚进攻长安，也急急引兵退走。
69. 陆逊坐镇皖城，等待前方捷报。不久，徐盛、朱桓、全琮先后赶到，报告各路大获全胜，魏兵投降的有几万人，遗下车仗马匹、军器粮食，不计其数。
page_text_en:
68. Sima Yi heard the news of Cao Xiu's defeat and, fearing that Kong Ming would take advantage of the situation to attack Chang'an, hastily withdrew his troops.
69. Lu Xun was stationed in Wancheng, awaiting reports from the front. Soon, Xu Sheng, Zhu Huan, and Quan Cong arrived one after another, reporting that all routes had achieved great victories, with tens of thousands of Wei soldiers surrendering, and countless carts, horses, weapons, and supplies left behind.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了司马懿因曹休大败而撤兵，以及陆逊在皖城接到徐盛、朱桓、全琮等将领凯旋报捷，魏军大量投降、物资损失惨重的场景。

source_file: 连环画《三国演义48：赚曹休》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
70. 陆逊高兴非常，先把周鲂请来，说这次立功，多亏了他的诈降计谋。
71. 接下又慰劳徐盛、朱桓、全琮等将。一面差人赶向孙权报捷。
page_text_en:
70. Lu Xun was extremely delighted. He first invited Zhou Fang, saying that this victory was largely due to his feigned surrender strategy.
71. He then rewarded the generals Xu Sheng, Zhu Huan, and Quan Cong. At the same time, he sent messengers to report the victory to Sun Quan.
summary_zh: 陆逊在皖城大胜后，先感谢周鲂的诈降计谋，随后慰劳徐盛、朱桓、全琮等将领，并派人向孙权报捷。

72. 陆逊把各处防务分派停当，自己同了周鲂、徐盛、朱桓、全琮一行班师回吴。
73. 孙权早得大破魏兵的消息，听到陆逊回来，率领文武百官，出武昌城迎接。
page_text_en:
72. Lu Xun assigned the defense duties at various locations, then returned to Wu with Zhou Fang, Xu Sheng, Zhu Huan, Quan Cong, and their troops.
73. Sun Quan had already received news of the great victory over the Wei army. Upon hearing that Lu Xun had returned, he led the civil and military officials out of Wuchang City to welcome him.
summary_zh: 陆逊在安排好各处防务后，与周鲂、徐盛、朱桓、全琮等将领班师回吴；孙权得知大破魏兵的消息后，率文武百官出武昌城迎接陆逊。

74. 陆逊拜见孙权，孙权连忙扶起，命侍臣用御伞替他遮阳，同回城内。
75. 孙权大排筵席，庆贺胜利，所有立功将士，尽皆升赏。
page_text_en:
74. Lu Xun paid homage to Sun Quan, who hurriedly helped him up, ordered attendants to use an imperial umbrella to shield him from the sun, and returned to the city together.
75. Sun Quan held a grand banquet to celebrate the victory, and all the meritorious generals and soldiers were promoted and rewarded.
summary_zh: 陆逊拜见孙权，孙权亲自扶起并以御伞遮阳，一同回城；随后孙权大摆筵席，庆贺胜利，并对所有立功将士进行升赏。

76. 孙权慰劳周鲂，说：“你割发促成破敌的大功，历史上应当给你大书一笔。”当下封周鲂为关内侯。
77. 陆逊乘机奏道：“这番曹休大败，足使魏国气馁，主公正好修下国书，遣使入蜀，一者显自己威风，二者教诸葛亮进兵中原。”孙权同意，随即备了国书，派遣使臣，出发向成都去了。欲知后事，请看下集《姜维献书》
page_text_en:
76. Sun Quan commended Zhou Fang, saying, "Your act of cutting your hair contributed greatly to defeating the enemy; history should record your achievement in grand terms." He immediately bestowed upon Zhou Fang the title of Marquis of Guannei.
77. Lu Xun seized the opportunity to advise, "This great defeat of Cao Xiu has greatly weakened Wei's morale. Your Majesty should now draft a formal letter and send an envoy to Shu, to show our own prestige and also to encourage Zhuge Liang to launch an offensive into the Central Plains." Sun Quan agreed, immediately prepared the letter, dispatched envoys, and sent them off to Chengdu. To learn what happens next, please read the next volume, 'Jiang Wei Presents the Letter.'
summary_zh: 孙权封赏周鲂，陆逊建议趁魏国大败之机修书遣使入蜀，以示威风并策动诸葛亮进兵中原，孙权同意并派遣使臣前往成都。
